behavioral_intents: Attackers programmatically disable or modify Windows Firewall rules to permit malicious network traffic or lateral movement by invoking firewall management tools via command line or COM objects.
Disabling IIS HTTP request logging to evade detection of web-based attack activity or data exfiltration
Adversaries modifying Windows Firewall policies to disable firewall protections and allow malicious inbound/outbound network activity.

Attackers modify Event Log channel CustomSD registry values to deny security principals (administrators, system, network service, audit) read/write access, effectively suppressing event logging to hide malicious activity.
